name: setUserColor
description: DEPRECATED — kept for ONE release for interface compatibility and scheduled for removal in the next release. The currently-served /v1/ guest (nexus_web main) still calls this route from its Settings · Appearance page, so removing it in the same build that serves that guest breaks the page; it stays accepted-but-deprecated until the per-client guest (resolveTheme + caller-localStorage) is the one being served. Behaviour is unchanged: set the profile's theme user colour via ThemeService::SetUserColorAndBrowserColorVariant (prefs browser.theme.user_color2 + color_variant2). Omit `color` to clear the user colour and fall back to the default palette. Like setColorScheme this repaints the guest through the existing nexus-theme push. Returns {ok:true}. New clients must use appearance.resolveTheme instead and own their colour state locally.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Seed colour as "#rrggbb" (case-insensitive). Absent or empty clears the user colour.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Colour variant: "tonalSpot", "neutral", "vibrant" or "expressive". Defaults to tonalSpot when absent.
